suppress.notes: SSE stream corruption with view fragments. This application exposes no Server-Sent Events endpoints: no SseEmitter, ServerSentEvent, or text/event-stream producer anywhere in src/main.

WebFlux + Aalto XML maxInMemorySize bypass. Requires WebFlux and the Aalto XML processor; this is a Spring MVC application (spring-boot-starter-web, no spring-boot-starter-webflux) and Aalto is not on the dependency tree.

Pre-flight header predicate bypass in WebFlux functional endpoints deployed on DispatcherServlet. No WebFlux on the classpath and no functional endpoints: zero RouterFunction/RouterFunctions usages. Routing is annotated controllers only.
Request headers exposed in a WebFlux WebSocket error path. No WebFlux and no WebSocket support is configured in this application.

User-supplied property paths through Spring's data binding infrastructure. This application does not use that infrastructure: zero occurrences of @ModelAttribute, @InitBinder, DataBinder, WebDataBinder or BeanWrapper in src/main. Request payloads arrive via @RequestBody (Jackson deserialisation) and @RequestParam/@PathVariable simple type conversion, none of which walk property paths.
SpEL safety guard bypass via SimpleEvaluationContext. This application evaluates no SpEL expressions: no SimpleEvaluationContext, ExpressionParser or SpelExpression usage in src/main.
SSE stream corruption via the functional web framework. Requires RouterFunction based routing and SSE; this application has neither.

XsltView SSRF/RCE (CVSS 9.8). Requires an MVC "/**" mapping that resolves to view rendering with the view name left unspecified, so a request path selects the view. This application renders no views: 7 @RestController classes, zero @Controller, no XsltView / ModelAndView / ViewResolver, and no template engine (no thymeleaf/freemarker/mustache/groovy-templates on the dependency tree). Every endpoint returns JSON via @ResponseBody.

PartEventHttpMessageReader ignores maxPartSize. Requires a WebFlux controller with an @RequestBody Flux<PartEvent> argument and maxInMemorySize set to -1. This is a Spring MVC application (spring-boot-starter-web, no spring-boot-starter-webflux); no Flux<PartEvent> handlers exist.

SpEL power-operator DoS on BigDecimal/BigInteger. Requires the application to evaluate untrusted SpEL expressions. It evaluates no SpEL at all: no ExpressionParser, SpelExpressionParser, SimpleEvaluationContext or StandardEvaluationContext usage in src/main.

RSocket memory leak via a malformed SETUP frame. Requires Spring RSocket messaging (RSocketMessageHandler). This application uses no RSocket: no spring-boot-starter-rsocket dependency and no RSocket types in src/main.

sameSite attribute dropped from response cookies on the Jetty 12 Core reactive adapter. Requires WebFlux deployed on Jetty 12 Core. This application is Spring MVC on the default embedded Tomcat; no WebFlux and no Jetty on the dependency tree. (Spring itself rates this Low; it is the NVD score that trips the gate.)

WebAuthn user-verification bypass with a distributed HTTP session store. This application does not use WebAuthn or passkeys, and is stateless (SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS) with JWT Bearer authentication -- there is no HTTP session store at all.

Spring Security's embedded UnboundID LDAP server registers an administrative credential and binds its listener broadly. This application uses no LDAP: no UnboundIdContainer, no spring-security-ldap dependency, and authentication is database-backed with JWT.

Open redirect in UrlHandlerFilter when configured with broadly matching patterns. This application registers no UrlHandlerFilter: no WebMvcConfigurer bean and no reference to UrlHandlerFilter anywhere in src/main.

Open redirect via UrlFileNameViewController mapped with an end-of-path pattern and no configured prefix. This application uses no UrlFileNameViewController: routing is annotated @RestController methods only.

Reflected XSS when a data-binding Errors instance with HTML escaping enabled is rendered via Errors.getFieldErrors()/getFieldError(). GlobalExceptionHandler does call ex.getBindingResult().getFieldErrors() (GlobalExceptionHandler.java), but it is a @RestControllerAdvice serialising the result to JSON via Jackson -- there is no HTML view rendering and no HTML-escaping Errors context anywhere in this app for the payload to reach.

Path traversal via Spring's FreeMarker integration when a controller returns an untrusted view name resolved through SpringTemplateLoader. This application has no FreeMarker dependency and renders no views at all -- it is a JSON REST API.

HTTP response splitting when a Content-Disposition header is built from untrusted input (e.g. a malicious file name). This application never sets a Content-Disposition header: no attachment/filename response header anywhere in src/main.

Sort validation bypass allowing inference of data via crafted sort payloads -- but per the advisory this requires a repository method that combines nativeQuery=true with a Sort/Pageable parameter. The only native query in this app, OutboxEventRepository.claimPending(int limit), takes no Sort/Pageable at all and its "limit" argument is an internal poll-batch-size config value, never request input. The one method that does accept Pageable, ActivityRepository.findByFilters, backs a plain JPQL @Query, not a native one.

AesBytesEncryptor's two-argument constructor (or a null IV generator with CBC mode) encrypts with an all-zero IV. This application never uses Spring Security's crypto module: no Encryptors/BytesEncryptor/TextEncryptor reference anywhere in src/main.

Non-constant-time comparison of security-sensitive values in DigestAuthenticationFilter, KeyBasedPersistenceTokenService (remember-me), the Password4j-backed password encoders, and InMemoryOAuth2AuthorizationService. This application uses none of the four: authentication is BCryptPasswordEncoder plus stateless JWT Bearer tokens, with no digest auth, no remember-me, and no OAuth2 authorization server component.
